ranking.name: Air temperature near the ground
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, air temperature near the ground in the Eastern US changed by +0.320 °C per decade (95% confidence interval +0.231 to +0.409), which is statistically significant (p < 0.001). Over the whole 24.7-year period that is an increase of about 0.789 °C.

ranking.name: Rain and snow (precipitation)
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, rain and snow (precipitation) in the Eastern US shows no statistically significant trend (p = 0.52): the estimate is +0.019 mm/day per decade (95% confidence interval −0.041 to +0.079). This does not mean nothing changed; the data cannot tell a trend this small apart from natural ups and downs.
